query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.documentation_file_count), 0)::BIGINT AS "count!"
           FROM releases r
           JOIN (
               SELECT DISTINCT ON (rid) rid, documentation_file_count
               FROM builds
               WHERE build_status = 'success'
               ORDER BY rid, id DESC
           ) b ON b.rid = r.id
           WHERE r.rustdoc_status = TRUE
